title: VoxelSMP
description: A Donutsmp like server where we are keeping shop and listening to the community and there ideas for the server
body: Welcome to **VoxelSMP**, the ultimate hardcore survival experience! Fight other players, raid enemy bases, build powerful alliances, and climb to the top of the economy. Every death has consequences, making every battle intense and every victory rewarding. Whether you're a solo grinder, a PvP warrior, or a master strategist, VoxelSMP offers endless action and competition. Do you have what it takes to survive, thrive, and become the richest player on the server
